<DOCSTRING>
Summary: Represents an answer in the system, facilitating the association between questions and alternatives.

Description: This class is used to model the relationship between questions and their possible answers. It is instantiated whenever a new answer needs to be created or when an existing answer is to be represented. The `Answer` class is utilized by various services and components to ensure that the correct question and alternative are linked.

Attributes:
    question_id (int): The ID of the question to which this answer relates. This is set during initialization and remains constant throughout the lifecycle of the object.
    alternative_id (int): The ID of the alternative answer associated with the question. This is also set during initialization and remains unchanged.
</DOCSTRING>
